issues.failure_explanation: The remark replaces the locally optimal (capped) step sizes of Algorithm algo: geometric MG by the fixed value $\lambda=(d+1)^{-1}$ and claims that 'All results of this section remain valid', in particular the contraction (eq: linearized MG contracion) 'where ... $q\in(0,1)$ is the contraction factor from Proposition lemma: MG contraction'. Proposition lemma: MG contraction is established (in [IMPS24]) only for the algorithm with the optimal step sizes; the fixed-step error propagator $\prod_{\ell'\ge1}(I-\lambda\,\SS_{\ell'})(I-\SS_0)$ is a different operator, and the source contains no argument giving any uniform contraction for it. Since the locally optimal step size $\nu_{\ell'}$ can be smaller than $\lambda$ (even arbitrarily small), the fixed-step level update need not decrease the error, so no contraction factor, let alone the same $q$, is available. The claim is load-bearing: the proof of Corollary corollary: symmetric MG optimality uses (eq: linearized MG contracion) both for positive definiteness of $\vec B^{\SMG}_\ell$ and for the bound $\operatorname{cond}_{\vec A_\ell}(\vec B^{\SMG}_\ell\vec A_\ell)\le(1+q^2)/(1-q^2)$.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Prove a uniform contraction factor for the fixed-step multiplicative multigrid operator (or directly an $h,p$-robust bound for cond$_{\vec A_\ell}(\vec B^{\SMG}_\ell\vec A_\ell)$) via the stable decomposition and strengthened Cauchy--Schwarz machinery already assembled in the paper, and adjust the constant in Corollary corollary: symmetric MG optimality accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: The linearized preconditioner $\vec B^{\MG}_\ell$ of Remark remark: linearized MG and the symmetric preconditioner $\vec B^{\SMG}_\ell$ of Section sec: symmetric MG lose their advertised guarantees (SPD-ness, $h$- and $p$-robust PCG contraction, optimality), and with them the advertised PCG+sMG solver within the optimal-complexity AFEM discussion; only the non-linear GPCG+MG results (Theorem theorem: main result) remain supported.
issues.title: Uniform contraction of the fixed-step-size (linearized) multigrid is asserted without proof
issues.why_classification: A complete resolution needs a new contained nontrivial lemma (standard successive-subspace-correction estimates) or a limited weakening to a still comparable PCG result; no advertised regime must be abandoned and the constants remain uniform, so this is more than minor but avoids new global architecture.

issues.failure_explanation: Step 2 reduces the lemma to the displayed estimate $\sum_{\ell'=1}^{\ell-1}\sum_{g_{\ell',z}=m}\enorm{\PP^1_{\ell',z}\widehat w_k}\lesssim\enorm{\widehat w_k}$ and bounds each summand via $\enorm{\PP^1_{\ell',z}\widehat w_k}\le\enorm{\widehat w_k}_{\widehat\omega^n_m(z)}$. After reindexing, the sum runs over all vertices $z\in\widehat\VV_m$, of which there are $\simeq\widehat h_m^{-d}$; the counting lemma only bounds the multiplicity per vertex, not the number of patches. For a fixed smooth level-$k$ function ($k<m$) a positive fraction of the generation-$m$ patches contributes $\gtrsim\enorm{\widehat w_k}\,\widehat h_m^{d/2}$, so the sum grows like $\widehat h_m^{-d/2}\enorm{\widehat w_k}$ and the claimed bound is false as an intermediate inequality; the $l^1$ summation over an unbounded number of patches cannot be repaired inside the given chain, so the proof of Lemma lemma: strengthened CS fails.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the $l^1$ patch summation by a square-summable argument: sharpen Step 1 to a patch-localized bound for the $\widehat v_k$-factor (energy norm over a slightly enlarged uniform patch) and then use finite patch overlap to control $\sum_z\enorm{\PP^1_{\ell',z}\widehat w_k}^2\lesssim\enorm{\widehat w_k}^2$, combining the two factors with the geometric weight $\delta^{m-k}$; alternatively invoke the corresponding established multilevel inequality from [FFPE17]/[IMPS24].
issues.overall_effect: The upper bound $a(\SS^{\AS}_\ell v,v)\le C\enorm{v}^2$ in Theorem theorem: AS operator (Step 3 uses the lemma) is unproven; hence the spectral bounds and the optimality claim cond$_{\vec A_\ell}(\vec B^{\AS}_\ell\vec A_\ell)\le C/c$ of Corollary theorem: AS condition number bound, and the advertised optimality of the additive Schwarz preconditioner within PCG, are unsupported. The lower bound and the symmetry part are unaffected.
issues.title: Invalid l1 patch-norm summation breaks the proof of the strengthened Cauchy--Schwarz inequality
issues.why_classification: The lemma statement itself is plausibly true and a contained, nontrivial re-argument (weighted $l^2$ summation with finite overlap) restores it, leaving the upper bound and Corollary theorem: AS condition number bound intact with unchanged rates; no advertised regime is lost, so the issue is moderate.
